steps.text: Talk to Ceril Carnillean in the south west of East Ardougne.
Enter the cave south east of the Clock Tower entrance.
Talk to Clivet. You can choose to either side with him or with the Carnilleans.
Go back to the surface.
Talk to Clivet for some poison.
Go back to the surface.
Climb down the ladder in the Carnillean house to the kitchen.
Use the poison on the range.
Leave the kitchen.
Talk to Ceril Carnillean to confirm the results of the poison.
Return to Clivet in the cave south of East Ardougne.
Return to Clivet.
Board the raft.
Talk to Alomone.
Search a crate in the Carnillean's kitchen for a key.
Search a crate in the Carnillean's kitchen for a key.
Search a crate in the Carnillean's basement kitchen for a key.
Search a crate in the Carnillean's basement kitchen for a key.
Go back upstairs from the kitchen.
Go upstairs in the house.
Knock the wall to enter the hidden room.
Knock the wall to enter the hidden room, then climb up the ladder.
Open the chest.
Return to Alomone with the scroll.
Return to Alomone with the scroll.
Return to Alomone with the scroll.
Return to Alomone with the scroll.
Return to Alomone with the scroll. If the raft doesn't go to Alomone, repeat the prior valve steps first.
Return to Alomone with the scroll.
Re-enter the cave.
Board the raft.
Talk to Alomone. Be ready to fight him (level 13).
Kill Alomone.
Retrieve armour from the chest. If you'd like to keep a set of the armour for yourself, drop it and search the chest for more.
Return to Ceril Carnillean.
Return to Ceril Carnillean.
Talk to Butler Jones.
Bring the armour to Ceril in house in the south west of East Ardougne.
Go upstairs in the house.
Search the cupboard in the east room.
Talk to Ceril to finish the quest.
Turn the valves near the cave to direct the underground water.

notes: If you sided with Hazeel and are being guided to help Ceril, just click the box in the Ceril sidebar header to switch to Hazeel
rewards: 2000 x (2,005 if siding with Ceril) Coins
Hazeel's mark (if you sided with Hazeel)
Carnillean armour (if you sided with Ceril)
